I'm sorry your order has stalled. Since tracking hasn't moved in 5 business days, you're past our 4-business-day threshold, so please contact support now to get a courier investigation opened.

**What happens next:**
- We open a courier investigation, which takes up to **5 business days**.
- If the package is found to be lost, you choose either a **free replacement** or a **full refund**.

**To get started:** reach us by chat (8am-8pm Mon-Sat, your local time) or email help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day). Please have your order number ready (it looks like LF-123456). Since I can't see order details here, that's the quickest way for the team to open the investigation.

One note: tracking can take up to 24 hours to update after shipping, but at 5 business days of no movement, that no longer applies.

Is there anything else about the order I can help with?
